subject.title: [Bug]: Container image upgrades skip openclaw upgrade migrations before gateway startup

question: Should direct gateway startup for container image replacement run safe pending upgrade migrations before readiness, or fail readiness until an explicit repair/update command completes them?
rationale: The decision changes startup-time mutation and readiness semantics for Docker/Kubernetes-style upgrades, so automation should not choose which doctor/update repairs are safe to run before the gateway reports ready.

options.title: Bounded startup migration gate
options.body: Run a maintainer-approved safe migration set under startup coordination before readiness, and fail readiness with actionable guidance for repairs that cannot safely run automatically.

options.title: Explicit repair-only contract
options.body: Keep gateway startup non-mutating and change readiness/status/docs so direct container replacement clearly reports pending upgrade work instead of appearing healthy.

options.title: Keep current startup behavior
options.body: Leave image replacement as an operator-managed flow, accepting that health/readiness may not imply upgrade migration convergence.

recommendation.title: Bounded startup migration gate
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-approved safe migration set under startup coordination before readiness, and fail readiness with actionable guidance for repairs that cannot safely run automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: openperf has the strongest recent history on the gateway startup migration guard surface where this policy would be enforced.
